blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Population prompts are widely used to generate synthetic survey responses, but they combine information supplied at inference with associations already encoded during pretraining. We introduce an alternative construction that maps declared aggregate preference anchors into group-indexed choice policies. For each population, the signs of six Global Preferences Survey (GPS) coordinates deterministically label a shared bank of paired synthetic responses, and Direct Preference Optimization fits a parameter-efficient adapter to those comparisons. We evaluate the adapters on candidate World Values Survey (WVS) items using prompts that omit country names and distinguish four questions: recovery of the imposed labels, transfer of the anchor signal to new text, coherence between the GPS anchors and human WVS responses, and agreement between adapter and human scores. The adapters recover the imposed pairwise labels. On a purposively selected sixteen-country development panel, adapter trust scores completely separate the two GPS-sign groups and have a rank correlation of (0.74) with continuous GPS trust scores. Human–GPS and adapter–human associations remain unresolved on the same panel, and results for the other preference dimensions are heterogeneous. These findings show that an anchored policy can retain a declared aggregate signal without thereby reproducing human response patterns. The contribution is therefore both an inspectable construction and an evaluation framework that separates anchor transfer from human criterion agreement.
blocks.zh: 人口提示被广泛用于生成合成调查回复,但它们将推断提供的信息与在预训期间已经编码的协会相结合. 我们引入了另一种构建方法,将宣布的总偏好锚地映入集团指数化的选择政策。 对每一人口而言,6个全球优惠调查(GPS)的标志协调了确定性标签,标出一个共享的组合合成反应库,直接优惠优化适合这些比较的参数效率适配器。 我们对候选世界价值调查(WVS)项目的适配器进行评估,使用省略国名并区分四个问题的提示:恢复强制标签,将锚信号转移到新的文本上,GPS锚地与人类WVS反应的一致性,适配器与人类得分一致. 适配器恢复被强制的对等标签. 在有目的地选定的16个国家开发面板上,适配器信任得分完全分离出两个GPS标志组,并具有连续GPS信任得分的排名关联(0.74). 人类-GPS和适配器-人类协会在同一板块上仍未得到解决,其他偏好层面的结果各不相同。 这些调查结果表明,一项固定政策可以保留一个已宣布的总信号,而不会重现人类的反应模式。 因此,这种贡献既是可检查的建筑,也是将锚地转让与人类标准协议分开的评价框架。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Group-level preference facts are expensive to obtain and easy to over-interpret. A proposed survey item must be piloted, translated, and fielded before researchers can assess whether it measures the intended attribute across populations. Language models offer a cheaper preliminary readout: researchers supply an item and a population description and obtain synthetic responses [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Yet sensitivity to prompting, compressed variance, and unstable subgroup comparisons limit the interpretation of those responses [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . In standard prompting pipelines, population conditioning remains opaque: responses inevitably confound the researcher’s intended demographic cues with associations acquired during pretraining. A central methodological question is what population information the researcher explicitly supplies and what subsequent comparisons can establish.
blocks.zh: 集团级的偏好事实很昂贵,容易被过度解释. 在研究人员评估拟议调查项目是否衡量各人群的预期属性之前,必须先进行试点、翻译和实地调查。 语言模型提供更便宜的初步读取:研究人员提供物品和人口描述并获得合成反应[1,2,3]. 然而,对引起、压缩差异和不稳定的分组比较的敏感性限制了对这些反应的解释[4、5、6]。 在标准的导出管道中,人口调节仍然不透明:反应不可避免地将研究人员的预期人口提示与在预训期间获得的协会混淆了。 一个核心的方法问题是,研究人员明确提供何种人口信息,以及随后的比较可以确定哪些信息。

blocks.en: We address this opacity by compiling declared aggregate preference signs into group-indexed parameter adapters. Specifically, we define a synthetic cultural agent as a group-indexed choice policy. It is neither an autonomous agent nor a sample of human respondents. A researcher declares aggregate preference benchmarks, takes their signs to deterministically label a shared bank of contrasting synthetic responses, and fits a parameter adapter for each population using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) [ 7 ] . We interpret this loss through a regularized Bradley–Terry pairwise choice model. Each adapter is jointly trained across multiple preference dimensions. At evaluation, the fitted policy assigns probabilities to candidate response codes for new survey items using a country-name-free prompt. Omitting the country name from the evaluation prompt removes that prompting channel. Pretrained associations remain in the base model.
blocks.zh: 我们处理这种不透明的问题,将已宣布的汇总偏好标志汇编成组索引参数适配器。 具体地说,我们把一种合成文化剂定义为一种集体指数化的选择政策. 它既不是自主的代理人,也不是人类被调查者的样本。 研究者宣布综合优先基准,取出其标志,确定一个共享的合成反应库,并使用直接优先优化(DPO)[7]为每个人群配上一个参数适配器。 我们通过一个正规的布拉德利-特里双向选择模型来解释这一损失. 每个适配器在多个偏好层面接受联合培训. 在评价时,适当的政策利用无国名的快捷方式,为新调查项目指定候选人答复代码的可能性。 从评价中删除国名会删除该提示频道。 训练有素的社团仍然在基本模式中。

blocks.en: Our empirical application evaluates this construction by linking country scores from the Global Preferences Survey (GPS) [ 8 ] to candidate items in World Values Survey (WVS) Wave 7 [ 9 ] . To assess what this pipeline establishes, we separate four distinct evaluation criteria: held-out synthetic-label recovery, cross-text anchor transfer, human cross-survey coherence, and model-human agreement. Internal recovery of synthetic labels confirms that optimization internalizes the training signs, whereas cross-text anchor transfer tests whether the coarse sign transfers to unseen survey items. Human cross-survey coherence evaluates whether human responses on the target instrument align with the external anchor, and model-human agreement measures direct concordance between policy scores and human survey distributions. These readouts target fundamentally different estimands: repeated language-model queries reduce Monte Carlo error around a functional of the model’s conditional distribution, whereas larger human samples reduce sampling error around a population functional. Moreover, because the construction relies entirely on published aggregate scores without access to individual-level microdata, the sign vectors do not identify within-group preference distributions. Group-level correspondence across countries faces standard ecological limits, meaning that cross-national alignment cannot establish individual-level measurement validity.
blocks.zh: 我们的经验应用通过将全球优惠调查(GPS)[8]的国家得分与世界价值调查(WVS)第七波[9]中的候选项目联系起来来评价这一构建. 为了评估这一管道建立的内容,我们分离出四个不同的评价标准:被搁置的合成标签回收、跨文本锚地转移、人类交叉调查的一致性和人类示范协议。 合成标签的内部回收证实,优化可使训练标志内部化,而跨文本锚地转移则测试粗口标志是否转移到隐形调查项目. 人类跨调查的一致性评价了人类对目标工具的反应是否与外部锚地一致,而示范人类协议衡量政策分数与人类调查分布之间的直接一致性。 这些读取目标根本上不同:重复的语言模型查询会减少围绕模型有条件分布功能的蒙特卡洛出错,而更大的人类样本则会减少围绕人群功能的取样出错. 此外,由于构造完全依赖于不访问个人层次微观数据的已公布的汇总分数,符号矢量无法识别组内偏好分布. 国家间的集团级通信面临标准的生态限制,这意味着跨国协调不能建立个人级的计量有效性.

blocks.en: In this application, internal recovery of synthetic labels is strong across all groups on held-out comparisons. On the trust dimension, the fitted policies transfer the coarse GPS sign to new item wording. The comparison with a country-named prompt is descriptive and is reported with the results. However, model-human agreement remains unresolved on this development panel, as does the human survey composite’s own coherence with the anchor. Across the remaining preference dimensions, performance diverges: while trust demonstrates directional anchor transfer, other traits display weak or conflicting associations across criteria. Distributional resemblance and directional anchor retention are separate criteria and can favor different saved configurations.
blocks.zh: 在这一应用中,在搁置比较中,合成标签的内部回收在所有群体中都十分有力。 在信任方面,配有的政策将粗糙的全球定位系统标志转移到新的项目措辞上。 与国名快报的比较是描述性的,随结果一起报告。 然而,关于这一发展小组的示范人类协议仍未解决,人类调查综合材料本身与锚地的一致性也是如此。 在其余的偏好方面,表现是不同的:虽然信任显示定向锚地转移,但其他特征显示各种标准之间的关联薄弱或相互冲突。 分布式相似和方向锚保留是独立的标准,可以倾向于不同的被保存的配置.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. First, we provide a compiler that maps declared aggregate preference signs into parameter adapters, establishing an inspectable route from population benchmarks to choice policies evaluated without country names. Second, we introduce an evaluation framework that explicitly separates internal label recovery, cross-text anchor transfer, human cross-survey coherence, and model-human agreement. Third, we offer an empirical proof of concept demonstrating that these validation criteria can sharply disagree: a policy can retain an external anchor while agreement with human response distributions remains unresolved. The intended application of this pipeline is group-level analysis and survey pre-piloting as a complement to field research. Whether using such policies for prospective item screening improves item selection before fielding a human survey remains an empirical hypothesis for a later human study.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 首先,我们提供了一个汇编器,将宣布的汇总偏好标志映入参数适配器,确定从人口基准到无国名评价的选择政策的可检查路线。 第二,我们引入一个评价框架,明确区分内部标签恢复、跨文本主播传输、人类跨调查一致性和模式-人类协议。 第三,我们提供了概念的实证证明,这些验证标准可能大相径庭:一项政策可以保留外部锚地,而与人类反应分布的协议仍未解决。 这一管道的预期应用是小组一级的分析和调查预试,作为对实地研究的补充。 在进行人类调查之前,是否将此类政策用于未来物品筛选改进了物品选择,这仍然是以后人类研究的经验假设。

blocks.en: 2 Related research
blocks.zh: 2 相关研究

blocks.en: Language models are used both to simulate survey responses and to adapt outputs to cultural communities. These purposes overlap technically, but the information supplied to a model and the evaluation target differ. Prompted synthetic respondents can resemble human samples on selected tasks [ 1 , 2 ] ; subsequent studies document sensitivity, compressed variation, and misportrayal of identity groups [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . Prior synthetic cultural-agent work uses cultural descriptions to study behavior in experiments [ 10 ] . We extend this research agenda by making aggregate preference signs the explicit population-specific labeling input.
blocks.zh: 语言模型既用于模拟调查答复,也用于使产出适应文化社区。 这些目的在技术上是重叠的,但提供给模型的信息和评价目标有所不同。 快速合成的应答者可以类似于选定任务的人类样本[1,2];随后的研究记录了敏感性,压缩了的变异,以及身份组的错相[4,5,6]. 之前的合成文化剂工作使用文化描述来研究实验中的行为[10]. 我们扩大这一研究议程,使总的偏好标志明确针对具体人口的标签。

blocks.en: Prompted simulation supplies a population description at inference and reads associations already present in the model. A structural demand or simulated-method-of-moments exercise would invert a named preference parameter from observed choice probabilities. We compile declared aggregate signs into a scoring policy. The GPS–WVS comparisons report criterion associations for that construction.
blocks.zh: 快速模拟提供了推断的人口描述并读取模型中已经存在的关联. 结构需求或模拟移动方法的演练将从观察到的选择概率中颠倒一个命名的偏好参数。 我们把公布的汇总标志汇编成评分政策。 GPS-WVS比较报告这种构造的标准关联。

blocks.en: Fine-tuning and cultural adaptation already occupy much of this methodological space. Table 1 identifies close comparisons. CultureLLM uses WVS seed data and semantic augmentation for culture-specific fine-tuning [ 11 ] . Cao et al. fit country-level survey response distributions and examine cross-survey evaluation [ 12 ] . SubPOP learns from subpopulation survey responses and tests transfer to new survey settings [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 微调和文化适应已经占据了这一方法空间的大部分。 表1列出了密切的比较。 CultureLLM使用WVS种子数据和语义增强来进行文化特有微调[11]. 曹等编. 适当分发国家一级的调查答复并审查交叉调查评价[12]。 亚POP从亚人口调查的回复和测试转移到了新的调查环境[13].

blocks.en: Culturally grounded preference optimization is also established in recent work. Jung and Kim generate preference triplets around Korean legal and social norms and fit cultural response policies with DPO [ 14 ] . The positive distinction of our approach lies in the specific combination of design choices: an external aggregate-sign input, a shared synthetic bank, a group-specific adapter, a country-name-free evaluation prompt, and an explicit split between anchor transfer and human agreement.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作还确立了基于文化的偏好优化。 Jung和Kim围绕韩国法律和社会规范产生偏好三重奏,并与DPO相适应文化对策[14]. 我们方法的积极区别在于设计选择的具体组合:外部的集成信号输入,共享合成库,特定组别适配器,无国名评价即时,以及锚地转让和人类协议的明确分割.

blocks.en: The data requirement differs from direct fitting of a new survey’s response distributions: construction uses existing aggregate anchors and synthetic contrasts before human responses to the new instrument are available. That distinction does not imply that scarce human observations should always be spent on training. Krsteski et al. examine the roles of prompting, fine-tuning, and statistical rectification when human data are limited [ 15 ] . Our proposed pre-pilot use must therefore be compared with alternatives that allocate human measurement effort differently.
blocks.zh: 数据要求不同于对新调查答复分布的直接配对:在获得人类对新仪器的答复之前,建筑使用现有的总锚地和合成对比。 这种区别并不意味着人类很少的观察应始终用于培训。 克尔斯泰斯基等. 在人类数据有限时,审查促进、微调和统计纠正的作用[15]。 因此,必须将我们提议的试点前使用与以不同方式分配人类测量努力的替代办法相比较。

blocks.en: The econometric interpretation follows work treating language models as conditional response distributions [ 16 ] , with DPO providing a reference-policy parameterization of Bradley–Terry comparisons [ 7 ] . The measurement interpretation requires more caution. Construct validity depends on cumulative evidence about the relation between a theoretical attribute and its measures [ 17 ] ; cross-national applications also require attention to comparability [ 18 , 19 ] . Agreement between an anchored policy and a survey may have several explanations, as may disagreement. We therefore report anchor retention and human agreement separately and treat the construction as a complement to human measurement.
blocks.zh: 计量经济学的解释遵循了将语言模型作为有条件响应分布的作品[16],DPO提供了布拉德利-特里比较[7]的参考政策参数. 衡量解释需要更加谨慎。 建构有效性取决于理论属性与其度量衡关系的累积证据;跨国应用也需要注意可比性[18,19]. 一项既定政策与一项调查之间的协议可能有几种不同的解释。 因此,我们分别报告锚地保留和人类协定,并将建筑作为人类计量的补充。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We separate the declared population input from the information already present in the models. The researcher chooses aggregate anchors, the synthetic contrast protocol, the fitting procedure, and the evaluation prompt. Declaring these inputs makes the conditioning rule inspectable. It does not restrict all information that can influence the fitted policy.
blocks.zh: 我们把宣布的人口投入与模型中已经提供的信息分开。 研究者选择了聚合锚,合成对比协议,适配程序,评价即时. 宣布这些投入使得条件规则可以检查. 它并不限制所有可能影响相应政策的信息。

blocks.en: If two anchor vectors have identical signs, they induce identical labels on the same bank. Holding the split and fitting randomness fixed therefore leaves the fitting problem unchanged. Distinct fitted outputs among such groups cannot be interpreted as recovery of anchor magnitudes. Moreover, a dimension-specific evaluation does not isolate a dimension-specific adapter: all coordinates contribute to the same fitted policy. A changed sign vector defines an intervention on the construction algorithm only. It does not identify a human preference counterfactual.

blocks.en: The map from declared signs through the shared bank to a fitted policy is a construction. The researcher supplies z c z_{c} , applies the labeling rule, and obtains the fitted choice policy π ^ c \widehat{\pi}_{c} . Identification would require invertibility of a named parameter from observed WVS option probabilities. The present design does not recover z c z_{c} , the magnitudes | z c ​ k | |z_{ck}| , a single GPS coordinate, or a cultural utility. blocks.en: 4 Empirical application and results

blocks.en: Evaluating the fitted policies on the target survey shows coarse trust-sign transfer, while agreement with human respondents remains unresolved. GPS supplies the anchors because its country scores are published aggregates of preference measures selected through prior experimental validation; they are not country-level collections of incentivized experimental choices. WVS Wave 7 serves as the target battery because it is a separate instrument, fielded on overlapping countries, whose items are candidate indicators for those same attributes. The item map is uneven on this panel, which makes the comparison informative: a policy trained on GPS signs can be tested for whether it retains those signs on WVS wording, and the same items can be tested for whether human country order agrees with GPS. Where the candidate map is weak, adapter–human disagreement can arise even when the construction successfully retains the anchor.
blocks.zh: 评估目标调查的配套政策显示,信托转让过于粗糙,而与接受调查者达成的协议仍未解决。 GPS提供锚点,因为其国家分数是公布的通过事先实验验证选定的偏好措施总量;它们不是国家一级奖励实验选择的集合. 妇女 第7波作为目标电池,因为它是一个单独的仪器,分布在重叠的国家,其项目是这些特性的候选指标。 这个面板上的项目图不均匀,这使比较信息丰富:可以测试是否保留了WVS措辞上的GPS标志,对相同的项目可以测试人类国家秩序是否同意GPS. 在候选地图薄弱的地方,即使建筑成功保留了锚地,适配器-人类也可能产生分歧.

blocks.en: Three empirical comparisons structure the findings. First, on trust, a profile adapter with a neutral prompt transfers the coarse GPS sign. The country-prompt comparison is descriptive and appears below. Second, agreement with human country ranks on this panel remains unresolved, as does the candidate map’s own association with the anchor across the same sixteen countries. Third, changing the evaluation prompt shifts both rank association and closeness to human response distributions, demonstrating sensitivity to configuration. The exhibits below provide the evidence for these three comparisons.

blocks.en: The diagnostic evaluation uses a purposively selected development panel of sixteen countries whose scores come from two saved jobs: Argentina, Brazil, China, Germany, Egypt, Great Britain, Greece, Indonesia, India, Japan, Mexico, Nigeria, the Netherlands, Russia, Turkey, and the United States. The first wave covers China, Japan, Great Britain, the United States, Mexico, Argentina, Germany, and Russia; the second covers India, Indonesia, Nigeria, Egypt, Turkey, the Netherlands, Brazil, and Greece. We assembled those waves to include both global sign polarities, the three duplicated sign profiles that share a labeling problem, mixed profiles, and geographic spread. The panel is not a probability sample of the forty-two-country GPS–WVS intersection. A later study that treats country selection as a sampling problem should train every country in that intersection or a predeclared random subset of it.

blocks.en: Held-out evaluations confirm that the adapters learned the imposed synthetic contrasts. Pair-pooled across 2,112 held-out country–pair cells, the DPO margin-improvement rate is 0.942 0.942 and pairwise synthetic-label accuracy is 0.819 0.819 . The former records a positive improvement in the chosen–rejected margin over the reference; the latter records a positive adapted-model margin itself. Country-level DPO margin-improvement rate ranges from 0.886 0.886 to 0.992 0.992 . These results support recovery of imposed synthetic contrasts, but they do not measure prediction of independently observed choices. The inspected training notebooks record a shared seed-42 split of 526 and 132, but they do not record why Russia’s holdout differs from that split. blocks.en: Configuration sensitivity is trait-dependent, demonstrating that adding a country-specific prompt shifts both rank association and distributional fit. On risk taking, adding a country prompt alters the direction of association with the anchor and shifts alignment with human responses. These shifts describe configuration sensitivity rather than separating latent priors from anchor effects or establishing a general division between weights determining direction and prompts determining shape. The historical base runs also vary numerically despite identical saved prompts because they are not checkpoint-equivalent; they are therefore not treated as a single fixed base distribution. Identical checkpoints, tokenizers, code strings, and scoring procedures were not established across those runs, leaving comparisons with the base model descriptive.
blocks.zh: 配置敏感性取决于特点,表明增加了针对具体国家的迅速分级关系和分级关系。 在承担风险方面,增加一个国家迅速改变与锚地的联系方向,并改变与人类反应的一致性。 这些转变描述的是配置敏感性,而不是将潜在的前科与锚地效应区分开来,或者在决定方向的权重和决定形状的导出之间确立一般的分出. 历史底盘的运行量也各不相同,尽管有相同的被保存的提示,因为它们不等同于检查站;因此,它们不被视为单一的固定基盘分布。 在整个过程中没有建立相同的检查站、标识器、代码串和打分程序,因此没有与基准模型描述进行比较。

blocks.en: The empirical evidence supports a fitted synthetic choice policy with trait-dependent external anchor association. Reliable prediction of human country ranks and practical pre-pilot benefits remain unestablished. We do not mix thirty-item total variation distance levels from earlier exploratory diagnostics with the strict-panel estimates, omitting that exhibit pending reconciliation of item eligibility and historical aggregation. A rank association alone cannot establish population dispersion.
blocks.zh: 经验证据支持一种与特性依赖的外部锚地协会相适应的合成选择政策。 对人类国家排名和实际的试点前效益的可靠预测仍未确定。 我们不将先前探索性诊断的30项总差异距离水平与严格的小组估计相混合,在核对项目资格和历史汇总之前略去这一显示。 单靠军衔协会不能造成人口分散。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The construction makes the rule translating declared aggregate preference signs into training labels explicit and auditable. A policy fitted to those labels can score new survey text without naming the population in the evaluation prompt, providing a controlled computational object for examining how supplied group information affects synthetic responses. This restriction applies to the declared conditioning channel, whereas pretrained representations and generator bank semantics remain embedded in the fitted model. We intend these policies to complement field work rather than replace human subjects or ascribe fixed cultural essences.
blocks.zh: 该构件使将宣布的汇总偏好标志转换成培训标签的规则具有明确性和可审计性。 与这些标签相匹配的政策可以在不指定评估即时人群的情况下对新的调查文本进行评分,为审查所提供的群体信息如何影响合成答复提供受控计算对象。 这一限制适用于已申报的调节道,而预先训练的表示和生成器的银行语义仍然被嵌入到安装的模型中. 我们打算这些政策补充实地工作,而不是取而代之,或写出固定的文化精髓。

blocks.en: The empirical application demonstrates that anchor fidelity and human resemblance are distinct. Recovery of synthetic labels confirms that optimization moved pairwise contrasts in the intended direction, and the fitted policies transfer the coarse trust sign to unseen survey items. Distributional resemblance to human choices is reported separately in Section 4 . That comparison describes two saved configurations. Identical checkpoints, tokenizers, code strings, and scoring procedures were not established. Agreement with human country responses remains uncertain on this panel, while exploratory dimensions reveal substantial cross-survey divergence. The fitted policies are scoring instruments; construct validity requires independent human evidence.
blocks.zh: 经验应用表明,锚定忠诚和人相貌是不同的。 恢复合成标签证实,优化将成对对比移向预定方向,而配套政策则将粗糙的信托标志转移到隐形调查项目上。 第4节单独报告了与人类选择的分布相似之处。 这一比较描述了两个已保存的配置。 没有建立同样的检查站、标识器、代码串和打分程序。 在这个小组中,与人类国家对策的一致仍不确定,而探索层面则显示出重大的交叉调查分歧。 相应的政策是评分工具;构建有效性需要独立的人类证据。

blocks.en: A prospective application of this construction is survey pre-piloting, where researchers score candidate questionnaire items against declared benchmarks to nominate items before fielding. However, our results do not demonstrate that synthetic scoring reduces fielding costs, improves item selection, or preserves validity in practice. Prospective pre-pilot item screening still needs an independent human study. Specifically, evaluating this workflow requires a blinded comparison of adapter-assisted selection against expert selection on a held-out human pilot, following the validation design in Appendix D . Scoring candidate items with synthetic respondents cannot establish measurement validity, and empirical human data remain indispensable for calibrating and rectifying model-assisted measures [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 这一构思的一个潜在应用是调查的先行性,即研究人员根据宣布的基准对候选人的问卷项目进行评分,以便在实地作业前提名项目。 然而,我们的结果没有表明,合成分数降低了实地成本,改善了物品选择,或在实践中保持了有效性。 未来的先行项目筛选仍然需要独立的人类研究. 具体而言,评估这一工作流程需要按照附录D中的验证设计,将适配器辅助选择与被搁置的人类飞行员的专家选择相盲目地进行比较。 将候选项目与合成答复者进行校正不能确定计量有效性,经验人类数据对于校正和纠正模型辅助措施仍然不可或缺[15].

blocks.en: Several limitations bound this evidence. The country panel is a purposively selected development panel of sixteen economies rather than a probability sample of the joint survey intersection. Duplicated sign profiles mean that countries with the same six signs share the same training labels, and sign-only supervision discards anchor magnitudes. In addition, the scenarios rely on a single shared bank whose loadings reflect generator judgments rather than experimentally verified trait manipulations. Omitting country tokens at evaluation does not remove pretraining exposure to public surveys, and joint optimization across traits prevents attributing item responses exclusively to any single anchor dimension.
blocks.zh: 这些证据受若干限制的约束。 国别小组是一个有目的地选定的由16个经济体组成的发展小组,而不是联合调查交叉点的概率样本。 重复的标志简介意味着,具有相同6个标志的国家共享相同的培训标签,而只使用标志的监管丢弃了锚量。 此外,这些设想还依赖于一个单一的共享银行,其装载量反映了发电机的判断,而不是经过实验核实的特性操纵。 在评价中标注国家标志并不能消除对公共调查的预先培训,而且各种特征的联合优化不能将项目答复完全归因于任何单一的主干层面。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We construct synthetic cultural agents by compiling the signs of declared aggregate preference anchors into group-indexed choice policies. A common bank of contrasting responses is labeled according to each group’s six-dimensional GPS sign profile, and a parameter-efficient adapter is fitted to those comparisons. Evaluating the resulting policies without country names in the prompt makes this population-specific labeling channel explicit and auditable. The fitted policy nevertheless remains jointly shaped by the pretrained model, the synthetic bank, and the complete sign profile.
blocks.zh: 我们通过将所宣布的总偏好锚点的标志汇编成集团指数化的选择政策来构建合成文化剂。 根据每个组的六维GPS标志配置,给一个常见的对比反应库贴上标签,并为这些比较安装了具有参数效率的适配器。 迅速评估没有国名的政策,使这一针对具体人口的标签渠道具有明确性和审计性。 然而,配套政策仍由经过预先训练的模型、合成库和完整的标志简介共同决定。

blocks.en: The empirical application shows why anchor transfer and human agreement must be evaluated separately. The adapters learned the imposed synthetic comparisons, and their trust scores transferred the coarse GPS sign to new WVS wording. This pattern did not generalize uniformly across the remaining preference dimensions. Moreover, agreement with human country responses remained unresolved on the sixteen-country development panel. The central finding is therefore not that the adapters reproduce national cultures. It is that retaining a declared anchor and resembling human respondents are distinct empirical achievements: success on the former does not establish the latter.
blocks.zh: 经验应用表明,为什么必须分别评价锚地转让和人类协议。 适配器学习了强制的合成比较,其信任分数将粗糙的GPS标志转移到了新的WVS措辞上. 这一模式没有统一概括其余的偏好层面。 此外,在16个国家发展小组问题上,与人类国家对策的一致仍未得到解决。 因此,主要的发现不是适应者复制了民族文化。 正因为如此,保留一个已宣布的锚和类似人类的答复者是独特的经验成就:前者的成功不能证明后者。

blocks.en: The appropriate interpretation of these adapters is consequently as inspectable scoring instruments rather than synthetic populations. They provide a way to study whether a declared aggregate signal survives transport to new item text, while independent human evidence remains necessary to determine whether that signal corresponds to the intended construct. The next test is prospective: predeclare a set of candidate survey items, compare adapter-assisted and expert item selection, and evaluate both against a blinded human pilot. Such a study would determine whether anchored scoring improves survey pre-piloting rather than merely reproducing its inputs.
blocks.zh: 因此,对这些适配器的适当解释是可检查的打分仪器,而不是合成组。 它们提供了一种方法,用以研究所申报的汇总信号是否仍能传送到新的项目文本中,而独立的人类证据仍有必要确定该信号是否与预期的构造相符。 下一个测试是预期的:预先宣布一套候选调查项目,比较适配器协助和专家项目选择,并对照失明的人类飞行员评价两者。 这种研究将确定锚定分数是否改进了调查的先行性,而不是仅仅复制其投入。

blocks.en: The following pseudocode describes the implemented logic in synthetic_generation/sca2_datagen/relabel.py , especially build_triplet_bank , sign_choice , and label_triplet_for_country . It is explanatory pseudocode rather than a claim that the complete replication package has been released. Recover shared (scenario, dimension, response A, response B) bank. blocks.en: The example below is triplet 00023ac74dac in triplets_bank.jsonl . The target is positive reciprocity. Argentina’s exported score is + 0.1596793085 +0.1596793085 ; its chosen option is A. This is an example of a deterministic training label. It does not describe an observed Argentine choice. Scenario. A fellow student tutored me for free before a critical exam, and now they’re facing a tight deadline for their own project and need someone to review their work. Decision: I can either take the time to thoroughly review their project or concentrate on my own study schedule. Trade-off: Helping my fellow student would acknowledge the effort they put into tutoring me, but it would cut into my own study time and potentially impact my performance. Response A. I’ll set aside time to carefully review their work this evening. They went out of their way to help me when it mattered most, and I want to make sure they know their effort made a difference. If I don’t take this seriously, it would feel like I’m ignoring the support that helped me succeed. Response B. I’ll let them know I can only do a quick scan tomorrow morning. My exam prep schedule is already packed with material I haven’t mastered yet, and I need to be realistic about what I can manage without burning out. I hope they understand my limitations in this situation. The Argentina metadata records signs ( − , + , − , + , + , − ) (-,+,-,+,+,-) in the order trust, risk taking, patience, altruism, positive reciprocity, negative reciprocity. Its policy is fitted jointly across these signs. A new WVS item, such as Q81 on confidence in charitable organizations, is then scored using the fitted adapter and the fixed code-likelihood readout. The scenario and Q81 are different texts. Their shared proposed dimension is an assumption of the map, and is not established by this example.

blocks.en: The current generation source records the following exact scenario-template instructions: Context: One realistic sentence establishing the agent, setting, and stakes. Decision: One sentence stating the two behaviorally plausible options the agent is choosing between. Trade-off: One sentence making the core target-facet tension explicit without naming high/low GPS scores. The fixed-pair prompt in generate.py includes these exact requirements: Generate two opposing responses to this same scenario. - Response A should load positively on the target dimension: it should express a higher level of the target trait/facet. - Response B should load negatively on the target dimension: it should express a lower level or absence of the target trait/facet. - Positive loading does not mean morally better, more polite, or more socially desirable. - Negative loading does not mean irrational, careless, hostile, or cartoonishly selfish. Other instructions request matching perspective, tone, length, stakes, and the remaining traits, and prohibit country labels. They express design intentions rather than verified controls. Complete source prompt templates are transcribed in the accompanying PROMPT_SOURCE_EXCERPTS.md . Current source text is distinguished there from archived realized evaluation prompts; a complete historical request log tying every generation call to an immutable provider revision has not been verified.

blocks.en: The saved evaluation preview and build_survey_user_prompt agree on the prompt wrapper without country tokens: Answer this questionnaire as an individual person. blocks.en: This manuscript does not field a new survey. The intended use of the fitted policies is to score candidate item text against declared GPS anchors before a human pilot. The following protocol is recorded so that a later study can test that use without changing the present construction.
blocks.zh: 这本手稿没有进行新的调查。 适用政策的用意是在人类飞行员面前,对照已申报的全球定位系统锚点对候选项目文本进行评分。 以下的协议被记录下来,以便以后的研究可以在不改变当前构造的情况下测试该用法.

blocks.en: A researcher predeclares a battery of candidate items, their recodes, and which GPS coordinate each item is proposed to track. Frozen adapters from the present study score those items with the space-prefixed code-likelihood readout without country tokens. Country composites are then ranked against GPS z z . Interpretation is comparative. Items that transfer the coarse GPS sign about as strongly as the nine-item trust map does in the forty-two-country human panel are retained as aligned candidates. Items that transfer the coarse sign where the corresponding human association on already-fielded items is near zero are set aside as likely echo of the training signs. Items that fail to transfer the coarse sign where the human map is strong are set aside as non-transporting.
blocks.zh: 研究人员预先宣布一组候选项目,其重编码,并提议由GPS协调每个项目进行跟踪. 本研究的冷冻适配器用没有国家标志的空间前置密码读出来评分这些项目。 国家复合材料随后以GPS z z 进行排名. 解释是比较的。 转让粗重的GPS标志的项目,与四十二国人类小组的九项信任地图一样,作为合格候选人保留。 转移粗体标志的项目,凡在已投放物品上对应的人类协会接近于零的,作为训练标志的回放。 人类地图坚固地未转移粗体标志的物品被作为非运输而搁置.

blocks.en: A human check then fields a small number of retained and flagged items in a predeclared set of countries, using the same recodes. The confirmatory estimand is human–GPS country-rank association on the new items, with a secondary adapter–human association. The study does not treat adapter–GPS alone as construct validation. Ethics review, consent, and sample-size planning belong to that later study.
blocks.zh: 然后使用同样的重编码,在预先申报的一组国家中进行人员检查,发现少量保留和标记的物品。 在新项目上, 研究并不将适配器- GPS 单独视为构造验证。 道德操守审查、同意和抽样规模规划属于后一研究。
